backfillRows.why: AoN instinct-8, Instinct Ability—Bestial Rage: "While raging, you gain your chosen animal's unarmed attack (or attacks), but you're unable to use weapons." The grant is printed as existing only while raging; without this field the 29 grantedStrikes rows (now reachable after animal-instinct#no-reader) would stand permanently, so an Animal barbarian would walk around with jaws out of combat. Record-level because the printed clause gates the whole grant. Reader: collectGrantedNaturals copies it onto NaturalAttack.requiresState (src/rules/build.ts) and deriveStrikes drops the Strike while c.classResources.rage is 0 (src/rules/derive.ts). classFeatures/animal-instinct carries no existing overlay row for this field (the overlay has whileActive / choice / edition / grantedStrikes only), so no supersedes. VERIFIER-ADDED: the builder filed this row as "DATA STILL NEEDED, the data-rows family's", but no other family's spec (.b035-rows-data-rows-1/-2, engine-1, instruments-1/-2, situational) emits it, so the reader would have shipped with no carrier.

backfillRows.why: AoN instinct-8, Specialization Ability (Level 7): "Increase the damage die size for the unarmed attacks granted by your chosen animal by one step, and increase the additional damage from Rage from 2 to 5 for your chosen animal's unarmed attacks." Only the flat-damage half was modelled (RAGE_DAMAGE tiers); the die step had no carrier, so a 7th-level Animal barbarian's Jaws stayed 1d10 where print makes it 1d12. Reader: applyUnarmedRiders (src/rules/derive.ts) already honours fromRecord + stepDie; minLevel is the level predicate added in this chunk, without which the step would fire at 1st. fromRecord keeps it off the barbarian's own Fist. classFeatures/animal-instinct carries no existing overlay row for unarmedTraits, so no supersedes.
